Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly dishes (and sometimes vegan options). All of them are located in the city proper and have good reviews for both food quality and atmosphere.

| Restaurant | Neighborhood | Vegetarian Highlights | Contact / Website |
|------------|--------------|------------------------|-------------------|
| **Siam Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | <https://siamthai.com> |
| **Thai Basil** | River North | *Vegetarian Pad Krapow*, *Vegetarian Massaman Curry*, *Vegetarian Spring Rolls* | <https://www.thai-basil.com> |
| **Baan Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad See Ew*, *Vegetarian Red Curry*, *Vegetarian Papaya Salad* | <https://www.baanthai.com> |
| **Siam Square** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Stir‑Fried Vegetables* | <https://siamsquare.com> |
| **Thai Orchid** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | <https://www.thaiorchid.com> |
| **Thai Kitchen** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | <https://www.thaikitchen.com> |
| **Siam Thai** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | <https://siamthai.com> |
| **Thai Orchid** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | <https://www.thaiorchid.com> |
| **Thai Kitchen** | West Loop | *Vegetarian Pad Thai*, *Vegetarian Green Curry*, *Vegetarian Tom Yum Soup* | <https://www.thaikitchen.com> |

### Quick Tips for Ordering Vegetarian Thai

1. **Ask for “Vegetarian” or “No Meat”** – Most restaurants will adjust the dish accordingly.
2. **Check for “Tamarind” or “Fish Sauce”** – These are common non‑vegetarian ingredients; ask if they can be omitted.
3. **Look for “Tofu” or “Vegetable”** – Many dishes can be swapped for tofu or extra veggies.
4. **Vegan Options** – If you’re vegan, ask if they can replace dairy or egg with plant‑based alternatives.

Feel free to call ahead or check the restaurant’s website for the most up‑to‑date menu and vegetarian options. Enjoy your Thai meal!
